premises.text: Professionals struggle with outdated tools for site investigation
premises.evidence_span: we have seen many professionals struggle out in the field doing site investigation

premises.text: Current site investigation methods are inefficient and require duplication of effort
premises.evidence_span: he's doing the same thing two or even three times. Once or twice on paper and again on the computer

premises.text: ArcSight can convert freehand input into precise geometry in real time
premises.evidence_span: ArcSight converts his freehand input into perfect, precise geometry

premises.text: ArcSight can recognize complex combinations of lines and arcs
premises.evidence_span: ArcSight can recognize any combinations of lines and arcs

premises.text: ArcSight allows users to organize data and collaborate with coworkers
premises.evidence_span: professionals can create and organize data and also to collaborate and share with their coworkers

premises.text: The engineering service industry is large and has not found a better solution until now
premises.evidence_span: Engineering service is a $200 billion industry. And all these professionals have been doing side investigation the same way, with pen and paper

value.text: Professionals can save time and improve efficiency in site investigation
value.evidence_span: this totally eliminates the need to recreate everything from scratch. That is a huge time saver

notes: No separate premises for features of ArcSight as they all contribute to the same solution.
